messages:
karen_cs: FYI Oxbriar on prod reporting spikes in p99 for embedding requests since ~09:10 UTC. Support ticket #54321. Intermittent timeouts from their app. Sending a couple sample request IDs: r-0a12b3c4, r-0b34d5e6.
mike_oncall: Got it — thanks Karen. Any recent deploys or infra changes? @jen_platform can you check for pool churn or preemptible evictions? :rotating_light:
karen_cs: No deploys from them or on our side in the window. Quick DB check: `SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE tenant='oxbriar' AND ts > now()-1h;` -> 2,300 reqs (normal). Observed p50 ~90ms p95 ~350ms p99 ~2300ms. I pulled some logs; many requests show seq_length ~16000 and model=redwood-embed-xxl.
sam_sre: Seq length ~16k for embeddings explains heavy tails — KV cache pressure + attention blowup. Do we have a sudden shift in payload size from client side?
karen_cs: Customer says they recently turned on a long-document pipeline (document search + dense retrieval before embedding) last night.
mike_oncall: Ok. Short-term mitigation options: 1) throttle tenant concurrency, 2) route tenant to a smaller model variant, or 3) give a short ephemeral reservation so they don't contend with noisy neighbors. Which do we prefer for immediate relief?
jen_platform: I can provision an ephemeral reservation and a priority-exemption rule for them for 2 hours. Also can push a fallback route: if latency > 600ms then use redwood-embed-xl instead of xxl for that tenant. ETA ~8m to create reservation and deploy canary.
karen_cs: I'll tell customer to implement client-side truncation of sequences > 8k and add exponential backoff (start 500ms -> 2s) while we apply infra mitigations. Sharing repro curl in case infra wants to reproduce locally:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-xxl","input":"<very long document here>"}'
```
mike_oncall: Good. I'll apply a temporary tenant_rate_limit=10rps and tenant_max_concurrency=8 to smooth tail and avoid queue head-of-line blocking. jen — can you add the reservation and the route?
jen_platform: Reservation created: res-7890. I added tenant=oxbriar to priority-exemption for pool `priority-ephemeral-1` for 2h. Also deployed canary fallback rule: `route(tenant=oxbriar) -> model=redwood-embed-xl if latency>600ms` (canary=10%). Logs for routed requests include `reservation=res-7890`.
tracing_bot: Trace r-0a12b3c4: backend_latency=2.1s, kernel_wait=1.1s, kv_cache_miss=true, seq_length=16384
oxbriar_prod_bot: Customer alert: after mitigation initial reports show p99 dropped to ~420ms over last 10m. Ticket updated (#54321) — customer says errors/timesouts appear resolved for now.
karen_cs: Customer confirmed improvement and asked about a permanent fix — discussing reserved capacity vs. quota/ingest limits. I'll loop in account team for options.
sam_sre: Recommend we add a post-incident note: persistent small reservation + client-side truncation guidance and doc updates about long-seq embedding costs. Also consider autoscaling knob for long-seq workloads.
mike_oncall: Agreed. If we see recurrence we'll escalate to runtime team to look at kernel-level attention optimizations and KV cache eviction heuristics. Closing this triage for now — follow-up action items: CS to contact customer about options, Platform to propose cost estimate for dedicated pool, SRE to draft postmortem entry. :thumbsup:
